name: Single-Leg Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Sit with your back against the leg press pad and place both forefeet on the lower platform with heels clear.
Press the sled out, release the catches and lift one foot clear while keeping the working knee softly bent.
Let that heel draw back until your calf stretches, then push through the forefoot to raise the sled.
Return both feet securely to the platform and engage the catches before switching legs.
tips: Hold the working knee steady so the ankle moves the sled.
Keep pressure across the ball of the foot throughout the press.
